finding.answer: Known, but consequences unknown, at signing

evidence.quote: "Change in Circumstance" shall mean any fact, change, event, occurrence, condition, circumstance or development with respect to the Company that was not actually known to the Company Board prior to the date of this Agreement (or, if known, the consequences of which were not known by the Company Board prior to the date of this Agreement); provided, that the receipt, existence or terms of an Acquisition Proposal shall not be deemed to be a Change in Circumstance.

finding.rationale: This agreement uses "Change in Circumstance" (no "Intervening Event" term) in Section 6.1 for the board's recommendation-change rights. Its Section 9.11 definition requires either that the fact/change/event was not actually known to the Company Board before signing, or, if known, that its consequences were not known before signing — i.e., a known event with unknown consequences qualifies.

evidence.quote: each share of Company Common Stock issued and outstanding immediately prior to the Effective Time will be converted, subject to the election and allocation procedures in [Section 2.3], into the right to receive either: (i) 0.48 fully paid and nonassessable shares (the "Exchange Ratio") of Nicolet Common Stock (the "Per Share Stock Consideration"), or (ii) Cash in the amount of $37.18 per share (the "Per Share Cash Consideration")

each holder of shares of Company Common Stock shall be provided an opportunity, (i) to elect to receive Nicolet Common Stock with respect to all of such holder's Company Common Stock (a "Stock Election"); (ii) to elect to receive cash with respect to all of such holder's Company Common Stock (a "Cash Election"); (iii) to elect to receive cash with respect to a portion of such holder's Company Common Stock and shares of Nicolet Common Stock with respect to such holder's remaining shares (a "Mixed Election")

If the number of Cash Election Shares is less than or equal to 1,237,000 (the "Cash Election Threshold"), then, at the Effective Time: (A) each Cash Election Share will be converted into the right to receive the Per Share Cash Consideration

finding.rationale: Section 2.1 lets each share convert into either 0.48 Nicolet shares or $37.18 cash, and Section 2.3 gives holders Stock, Cash, or Mixed Elections, with proration around the 1,237,000-share Cash Election Threshold. This is mixed cash/stock consideration structured as a holder election, so the correct option is "Mixed Cash/Stock: Election."
